name: update-page-properties
description: Updates a Notion page's or database row's properties, such as its status, a date or a select, given as Notion's own property values keyed by property name, and renames it with title (titleProperty names the title column: Name by default, title for a page under a page). A row's id comes from notion__query-database, whose rows also show the property names; a page's id from notion__search-pages-and-databases. Answers updated and the page's id and url.

pageId.description: A Notion page ID or URL. For URLs, the trailing 32 hexadecimal characters are used as the page ID.

properties.description: Notion property values keyed by property name, such as { "Status": { "status": { "name": "Done" } } }. Give properties, a title, or both.

titleProperty.description: Name of the title property. Defaults to Name; use title for a page nested under another page.
